employment_by_industry_by_county.source: 主計總處 79年戶口及住宅普查 就業狀況結果表(1990, 全查)；84年人口及居住調查(1995, 普查中間年抽樣)；人力資源調查 「就業者之行業─按地區分」年資料(2015-2025, data.gov.tw dataset 34113)
employment_by_industry_by_county.unit: % of employed persons aged 15+ by industry (rounded 0.1; rows sum to ~100); employed_thousand = employed persons in thousands
employment_by_industry_by_county.notes: Categories: agriculture=農林漁牧; mining_utilities=礦業+水電燃氣(+用水污染整治); manufacturing; construction=營造; commerce=批發零售(含國際貿易)+住宿餐飲(餐旅); public_education_health=公共行政+教育+醫療保健社工 (1990: 公共行政+社會服務業[教育/醫療/社福等]; 1995: 公共行政+社會服務及個人服務, so 1995 includes personal services and is not strictly comparable); other_services=運輸倉儲通信, 金融保險不動產, 工商/專業服務, 個人及其他服務. 1990/1995 are given both by the units of the time (by_historical_unit: 臺北縣, 臺中縣, 臺中市(省轄), 臺南縣, 高雄縣, 高雄市(院轄) etc.) and summed into today's 22 units (by_current_22; 金門/連江 not covered by 臺灣地區 tables). 1990 census excludes armed forces; 1995 survey counts in thousands (small counties rounded). Manpower-survey county estimates (2015+) have sampling error, esp. for 澎湖/臺東/嘉義市. GAP: no official online county-by-industry tables found for 1961-1989 or 1996-2014 (1966/1980 census reports and pre-2015 manpower yearbooks are not online as tables; 2000/2010 census county tables sit behind census.dgbas.gov.tw which blocks automated access).

farm_household_share_by_county.source: 主計總處 農林漁牧業普查: 84年(1995) 農牧戶數按專兼業分 / 獨資漁戶數按專兼業分; 104年(2015) 表1 從事農牧業之農牧戶家數; 109年(2020) 表33 從業農牧戶家數, 漁業 表22 從業獨資漁戶家數; denominators = 內政部 戶籍登記戶數 (年底, 內政統計查詢網 c0110101); national series from 歷次普查結果摘要表
farm_household_share_by_county.unit: households; share = farm (or fishing) households / all registered households in the county, %

national_summary.source: 歷次普查結果摘要表 (農牧戶占全國總戶數比率 %)

farm_household_share_by_county.notes: 1995 counts ALL 農牧戶 (incl. part-time); 2015/2020 count only households actually operating farming that year (從事/從業農牧戶), so 2015/2020 are slightly lower by definition (national 2020: 691,477 operating vs 761,854 all). Fishing = 獨資漁戶 (sole-proprietor fishing households). 1995 臺中市/嘉義市 fishing counts suppressed (D) by DGBAS. Census household counts vs registered households: registered households include many one-person registrations, so shares are lower bounds of the share of people living on farms; national 農牧戶人口 share is given in national_summary. County tables for 1960-1990 censuses are not online (only national summary).
